title: KOREA NATIONAL PARK SERVICE ACT
full_text:
KOREA NATIONAL PARK SERVICE ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)

The purpose of this Act is to promote the sustainable use of national parks and other natural parks by establishing the Korea National Park Service to systematically conserve and manage their natural ecosystems, natural and cultural landscapes, and topographical and geological resources, and thereby enable the public to lead healthy and leisurely lives in a pleasant natural environment. <Amended on Oct. 16, 2018>

Article 2 (Legal Personality)

The Korea National Park Service (hereinafter referred to as the “Service”) shall be a corporation. <Amended on Oct. 16, 2018>

Article 3 (Offices)

(1) The location of the principal office of the Service shall be prescribed by its articles of incorporation.

(2) The Service may establish park offices and other subordinate organizations as prescribed by its articles of incorporation.

Article 3-2 (Articles of Incorporation)

(1) The articles of incorporation of the Service shall include the following matters:

1. Purpose;
2. Name;
3. Location of its principal office;
4. Matters concerning executive officers and employees;
5. Matters concerning the board of directors;
6. Its business and the execution thereof;
7. Property and accounting;
8. Methods of public notice;
9. Amendments to its articles of incorporation.

(2) Where the Service intends to amend its articles of incorporation, it shall obtain authorization from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025>

Article 4 (Registration)

(1) The Service shall be established upon registration of its incorporation at the location of its principal office.

(2) Except as otherwise provided in this Act, the provisions of the Civil Act concerning incorporated foundations shall apply mutatis mutandis to registration of incorporation under paragraph (1).

Article 5 (Executive Officers)

(1) The Service shall have, as its executive officers, not more than 15 directors, including one president, and one auditor. <Amended on Nov. 11, 2025>

(2) Executive officers other than the president and the standing directors prescribed by the articles of incorporation shall serve on a non-standing basis. <Added on Nov. 11, 2025>

Article 6 (Appointment of Agents)

The president may appoint agents from among the employees, as prescribed by the articles of incorporation, to perform judicial or extrajudicial acts concerning the business of the Service.

Article 7 (Appointment and Dismissal of Employees)

The employees of the Service shall be appointed and dismissed by the president, as prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 8 (Duty to Maintain Confidentiality)

No current or former executive officer or employee of the Service shall disclose or misappropriate confidential information acquired in the course of duties.

Article 9 (Business Activities)

The Service shall conduct the following business activities: <Amended on Oct. 16, 2018; Jun. 10, 2022; Nov. 11, 2025>

1. Conservation of national parks;
2. Protection of wildlife in national parks and restoration of endangered species;
3. Management of diseases in wild animals in national parks, and rescue and treatment of such animals;
4. Installation and management of park facilities;
5. Prevention of, preparedness for, response to, and recovery from disasters in national parks, and related support;
6. Organization and operation of national park rescue teams performing duties such as accident prevention, rescue, and emergency medical services for visitors to national parks;
7. Surveys and research on natural park resources;
8. Cleaning of natural parks;
9. Guidance and publicity concerning the use of natural parks;
10. Development, education, dissemination, and operation of visitor programs, including experiential activities related to natural parks and interpretive programs for visitors;
11. Matters concerning surveys and research on the effects of climate change on natural park ecosystems and ecological restoration;
12. Matters concerning international cooperation related to the conservation and management of natural parks;
13. Business activities that the Service may conduct under other statutes and regulations;
14. Business activities entrusted by the Government or local governments;
15. Other business activities prescribed by Presidential Decree to achieve the purposes for which the Service is established;
16. Matters prescribed by the articles of incorporation as activities incidental to the business activities specified in subparagraphs 1 through 15.

Article 10 (Raising Funds, Etc.)

(1) Funds necessary for the operation and business activities of the Service shall be raised through the following means:

1. Contributions or subsidies from the Government or persons other than the Government;
2. Revenue from business activities under Article 9;
3. Borrowings under Article 13;
4. Donations from persons other than the Government;
5. Other revenue prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

(2) Matters necessary for the payment, management, and use of government contributions under paragraph (1) 1 shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 11 (Investments, Etc.)

(1) Where necessary for the efficient conduct of its business activities, the Service may make investments in or contributions to the business activities under Article 9.

(2) Matters necessary for investments or contributions under paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 12 (Collection of Fees)

The Service may collect fees and other actual expenses for business activities under Article 9 with approval from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025>

Article 13 (Borrowing of Funds)

Where necessary for business activities under Article 9, the Service may borrow funds with approval from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025>

Article 14 (Approval of Business Operation Plans, Etc.)

The Service shall obtain the approval of the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment for its business operation plan and budget for each fiscal year, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. The same shall also apply where the Service intends to amend an approved business operation plan or budget. <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025>

Article 15 (Disposition of Surplus)

Where the settlement of accounts for a fiscal year results in a profit, the Service shall dispose of that profit in the following order:

1. Covering losses carried forward;
2. Setting aside business reserves, as prescribed by Presidential Decree;
3. Payment to the National Treasury.

Article 16 (Lease of State Property, Etc.)

(1) Where the Government deems it necessary for the efficient performance of the Service’s duties, it may, notwithstanding the State Property Act, lease State property (including goods; hereinafter the same shall apply) to the Service free of charge or permit the Service to use such property free of charge.

(2) Where a local government deems it necessary for duties such as the management of national parks, it may, notwithstanding the Public Property and Commodity Management Act, lease real estate owned by that local government, including land and buildings, to the Service free of charge or permit the Service to use such real estate free of charge.

Article 17 (Sublease of State Property, Etc.)

(1) The Service may lease out property it has received as contributions under Article 10 or sublease property leased to it under Article 16, to the extent that doing so does not interfere with the management and operation of park facilities.

(2) Where the Service intends to sublease, under paragraph (1), property leased to it, it shall prepare a plan in advance and obtain the approval of the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. The same shall also apply where the Service intends to amend that plan. <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025>

(3) A person who leases or subleases property under paragraph (1) shall not permit another person to use or derive profits from the property or lease it to another person.

(4) A person who leases or subleases property under paragraph (1) shall not install buildings or other permanent structures on the land: Provided, That this shall not apply to structures that the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment deems necessary to achieve administrative purposes or for the Service’s duties and that are installed on condition of donation. <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025>

Article 18 (Use of the Service’s Property, Etc. Free of Charge)

Where property owned or managed by the Service is needed by an administrative agency or nonprofit corporation directly related to the performance of the Service’s duties, including the management and operation of natural parks, the Service shall permit its use free of charge, as determined by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment in consultation with the heads of relevant central administrative agencies. <Amended on May 26, 2020; Oct. 1, 2025>

Article 19 (Purchase of Land, Etc.)

The Service may, with the approval of the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, purchase or sell land necessary to achieve the purpose of its establishment and fixtures attached to such land. <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025>

Article 20 (Exemption from Obligations to Purchase Bonds, Etc.)

Where the Service acquires movable or immovable property for its business or operations, it shall be exempt from obligations to purchase various bonds and other instruments imposed by other statutes and regulations, in the same manner as State agencies.

Article 21 (Subrogation in Requests for Registration)

Where, in performing duties entrusted to it under this Act or the Natural Parks Act, the Service is required to register rights to real estate acquired by the State or a local government pursuant to Article 98 of the Registration of Real Estate Act, it may request such registration in place of the State or local government.

Article 22 (Regulations of the Service)

When establishing regulations concerning its organization, accounting, personnel affairs, remuneration, and other matters, the Service shall obtain the prior approval of the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. The same shall also apply where the Service intends to amend any matter so approved. <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025>

Article 23 (Requests for Relevant Materials, Etc.)

Where necessary in carrying out the business under Article 9, the Service may request relevant administrative agencies, local governments, or other persons, as necessary, to permit the inspection or copying of relevant materials, including documents, or to provide other necessary cooperation.

Article 24 (Guidance and Supervision)

(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall guide and supervise the Service with respect to the following matters and, where deemed necessary, may require the Service to report on matters concerning its business, accounting, and property or require public officials under the Minister’s authority to inspect the Service’s books, documents, facilities, and other objects: <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025>

1. Matters concerning duties entrusted to the Service by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment under the Natural Parks Act and other statutes and regulations;
2. Matters concerning the implementation of management guidelines under Article 50 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions;
3. Matters concerning the formulation and implementation of business plans and the preparation of budgets for each fiscal year;
4. Other matters prescribed by other statutes and regulations.

(2) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment discovers any unlawful or improper matter as a result of guidance, supervision, or inspections under paragraph (1), the Minister may order the Service to correct that matter. <Amended on Oct. 1, 2025>

(3) Public officials providing guidance or supervision or conducting inspections under paragraph (1) shall carry identification indicating their authority and present it to the persons concerned.

Article 25 (Application Mutatis Mutandis of the Civil Act)

Except for matters prescribed in this Act, the Natural Parks Act, and the Act on the Management of Public Institutions, the provisions of the Civil Act concerning incorporated foundations shall apply mutatis mutandis to the Service.

Article 26 (Penalty Provisions)

Any person who, in violation of Article 8, discloses or misappropriates confidential information acquired in the course of duties shall be punished by imprisonment with labor for not more than 2 years or by a fine not exceeding 20 million won.

ADDENDA <Act No. 14226, May 29, 2016>

Article 1 (Effective Date)

This Act shall enter into force one year after the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Period of Validity of Special Cases concerning State Property)

(1) Article 16 (1) shall remain effective until December 31, 2025.

(2) A lease or use of State property leased to or used by the Service free of charge pursuant to Article 16 (1) shall remain effective even after the period of validity under paragraph (1) expires, within the term of the lease or use of the relevant State property.

Article 3 (Applicability concerning Exemption from the Obligation to Purchase Bonds, etc.)

Article 20 shall apply beginning with cases in which the Service acquires movable or immovable property after this Act enters into force.

Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning the Korea National Park Management Service)

(1) The Korea National Park Management Service established under the former Natural Parks Act and existing at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed the Korea National Park Management Service established under this Act.

(2) The name of the Korea National Park Management Service appearing in registers and other public records concerning the property, rights, and obligations of the Korea National Park Management Service established under the former Natural Parks Act as at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed the name of the Service.

(3) Projects undertaken, dispositions made, and other acts performed by the Korea National Park Management Service under the former Natural Parks Act, and applications and other acts made or performed with respect to the Korea National Park Management Service, as at the time this Act enters into force, shall be deemed acts of the Service or acts with respect to the Service under this Act.

(4) Executive officers and employees of the Korea National Park Management Service established under the former Natural Parks Act as at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed executive officers and employees of the Korea National Park Management Service under this Act. In such cases, the terms of office of the executive officers shall be the remainder of their terms under the articles of incorporation of the Korea National Park Management Service.

Article 5 (Transitional Measures concerning Leases of State Property, etc.)

(1) State property, or land, buildings, and other real property owned by a local government, leased to the Service or for which the Service has been granted permission for use under Article 59 of the former Natural Parks Act as at the time this Act enters into force shall remain subject to the former provisions until the relevant lease term or period of permission for use expires.

(2) Property, State property, or land, buildings, and other real property owned by a local government that the Service has leased out or subleased under Article 60 of the former Natural Parks Act as at the time this Act enters into force shall remain subject to the former provisions until the relevant lease or sublease term expires.

(3) Property of the Service that the Service has allowed another administrative agency or a nonprofit corporation to use free of charge under Article 67 of the former Natural Parks Act as at the time this Act enters into force shall remain subject to the former provisions until the relevant period of use expires.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Acts)

(1) The Steep Slope Disaster Prevention Act is partially amended as follows:

Article 2, subparagraph 5 (h), shall be amended as follows:

(h) The Korea National Park Management Service under the Korea National Park Management Service Act.

(2) The Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act is partially amended as follows:

In Article 48, “the Korea National Park Management Service under the Natural Parks Act” shall be replaced with “the Korea National Park Management Service under the Korea National Park Management Service Act”.

Article 7 (Relationship with Other Statutes and Regulations)

Where any other statute or regulation cites a provision of Chapter VI of the former Natural Parks Act as at the time this Act enters into force, and this Act contains a corresponding provision, the corresponding provision of this Act shall be deemed cited in lieu of the former provision.

ADDENDA <Act No. 15830, Oct. 16, 2018>

Article 1 (Effective Date)

This Act shall enter into force three months after the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Succession to Rights and Obligations)

The name of the Korea National Park Management Service appearing in registers and other public records before this Act enters into force shall be deemed the name of the Service under this Act.

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Acts)

(1) The Steep Slope Disaster Prevention Act is partially amended as follows:

In Article 2, subparagraph 5 (h), “the Korea National Park Management Service under the Korea National Park Management Service Act” shall be replaced with “the Korea National Park Service under the Korea National Park Service Act”.

(2) The Act on the Persons Performing the Duties of Judicial Police Officials and the Scope of Their Duties is partially amended as follows:

In the heading of Article 7-2, “Korea National Park Management Service” shall be replaced with “Korea National Park Service”; in the same Article, “the Korea National Park Management Service or” shall be replaced with “the Korea National Park Service or”, and “president of the Korea National Park Management Service” shall be replaced with “president of the Korea National Park Service”.

(3) The Forest Protection Act is partially amended as follows:

In Article 32 (2), “Korea National Park Management Service” shall be replaced with “Korea National Park Service”.

In Article 39 (1) 5, “Korea National Park Management Service” shall be replaced with “Korea National Park Service”.

(4) The Natural Parks Act is partially amended as follows:

In the proviso to Article 42 (1), “the Korea National Park Management Service under the Korea National Park Management Service Act” shall be replaced with “the Korea National Park Service under the Korea National Park Service Act”.

(5) The Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act is partially amended as follows:

In Article 48, “the Korea National Park Management Service under the Korea National Park Management Service Act” shall be replaced with “the Korea National Park Service under the Korea National Park Service Act”.

ADDENDA (Act on Partial Amendments to 65 Acts under the Jurisdiction of the Environment and Labor Committee for the Revision of Legal Terminology) <Act No. 17326, May 26, 2020>

This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso Omitted>

ADDENDA <Act No. 18903, Jun. 10, 2022>

This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 21065, Oct. 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Effective Date)

This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That, among the Acts amended under Article 7 of the Addenda, the provisions amending Acts promulgated before this Act enters into force whose effective dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective effective dates of those Acts ... <Omitted> ... .

Subparagraphs 1 and 2 Omitted.

Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Acts)

Paragraphs (1) through (324) Omitted.

(325) The Korea National Park Service Act is partially amended as follows:

In Article 3-2 (2), Articles 12 and 13, the former part of Article 14, the former part of Article 17 (2), the proviso to Article 17 (4), Articles 18 and 19, the former part of Article 22, the part of Article 24 (1) other than its subparagraphs, Article 24 (1) 1, and Article 24 (2), each occurrence of “Minister of Environment” shall be replaced with “Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment”.

Paragraphs (326) through (626) Omitted.

Article 8 Omitted.

ADDENDA <Act No. 21120, Nov. 11, 2025>

Article 1 (Effective Date)

This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Applicability concerning the Election of Standing Directors and Directors)

The amended provisions of Article 5 shall apply beginning with cases in which standing directors and directors are elected under those amended provisions after this Act enters into force.
